items.criterion: Two simultaneous registrations hold two distinct contiguous founder places
items.judgment: The founder_slots positions after a concurrent run are exactly 1 to N with no duplicate

items.criterion: An emailed access link opens a session that reports the registrant's founder place
items.judgment: The access page confirms the link and GET /api/beta/status returns the stored position, tier and price

items.criterion: Each held founder place carries one Kill Bill account with the pinned key
items.judgment: The account for lumen-founder-NNNN reads back with the registrant's email, USD and US

items.criterion: The access email reaches the registrant alone with the pinned subject and first line
items.judgment: The Mailpit message carries one recipient, the pinned subject and the absolute link as its first plain-text line

items.criterion: The thousandth founder place is the last one the cohort hands out
items.judgment: After the cohort fills, the allocation reads closed and founder_slots holds exactly one thousand rows

items.criterion: Every operator endpoint refuses a visitor and a registrant session
items.judgment: Each operator call from an unauthenticated client answers 401 or 403 and the protected rows are unchanged

items.criterion: A link opens at most five times and the sixth open sends a fresh one
items.judgment: The sixth open answers a client error with the used-up page and a second message reaches the inbox

items.criterion: Simultaneous opens of one link never push the counter past five
items.judgment: After eight simultaneous opens the stored opens value equals five

items.criterion: The raw access token is stored only as a hash
items.judgment: No column of the access_links row carries the emailed token

items.criterion: Publishing a release moves the changelog, the redirect and the feed at once
items.judgment: The published build becomes the redirect target and the first feed item, and a revoke restores the previous stable

items.criterion: Each download redirect records exactly one download event
items.judgment: The stored download_events count and the reported download_count both rise by one per redirect

items.criterion: An invalid registration is refused with an errors object and stores nothing
items.judgment: Each invalid submission answers a client error carrying errors keyed by field and writes no row

items.criterion: Checkout and licence activation are refused before 1.0
items.judgment: Both endpoints answer a client error with the pinned error value and the billing tenant gains no account or invoice

items.criterion: The seeded rows exist exactly once after a restart
items.judgment: One row holds each seeded operator, registrant, link and release

items.criterion: The cohort figures equal the places actually held
items.judgment: The allocation endpoint reports the stored claimed count, remaining, tier and price

items.criterion: The update feed repeats the registry values unchanged
items.judgment: Each feed enclosure carries the stored download address, size and signature, with no item for a revoked release

items.criterion: Every response carries the three security headers
items.judgment: The transport, content-type and referrer headers are present on pages, API calls and the redirect alike

items.criterion: The sitemap lists the sixteen content routes and nothing else
items.judgment: Every sitemap address is absolute and the set equals the sixteen content routes

items.criterion: Every internal link on a public route resolves
items.judgment: Each link harvested from the content routes answers below 400

items.criterion: The distribution panel reads its values from the release registry
items.judgment: The current version, build, requirement and checksum on the download page match the stored release
